text: How do we work? Clear steps: register the land, then verify and inspect it, then the plan and the feasibility, then the service contract, then the work, proven step by step… all the way to harvest and sale.
Register your land for free: its location, its size, its water source, and its papers. It is shown to no one until an inspector verifies it.
On the map, you see Sudan by satellite, with the land, the canals, the soil, and the rain.
Rain forecasts on the map of Sudan, renewed every day… so you know when to plant.
The water calculator estimates how much irrigation your crop needs, by climate and growth stage.
The feasibility study works out the cost, the return, and the risks… before you spend a single pound.
The platform introduces you to new crops suited to your land, with their yields and prices from trusted sources.
The crop market: prices from the Gedaref exchange and the El Obeid market, from their bulletins, each price with its date.
The board of offers to buy and sell connects the seller with the buyer directly.
Prices of inputs and fuel: seeds, fertilisers, and diesel.
The pound's exchange rates, official and parallel, on one page.
The catalogue of services: ploughing, irrigation, crop protection, harvest, packing, and transport… carried out by verified partner companies.
Farming companies register themselves, and the matching farms appear to them… without the owner's name until the owner accepts.
Suppliers of seeds, fertilisers, and pesticides, with their verified licences.
Each season has one contract, with its stages, dates, and amounts. No stage is paid before it is proven by a photo, an invoice, or an inspection.
And the season's account book: every expense by its item, spending against the budget, and the net profit per feddan.
An inspection report on the land before you commit, and the season followed stage by stage… from wherever you are.
For livestock: the herd record, disease alerts, and readiness for export.
The export file: for every product and destination, its requirements and documents… from the farm to the port.
Mining: the price of gold every day, and the record of Sudan's minerals.
Nafir: irrigation canals, faza'a, shura, and judiyya… so the people of an area work together.
A knowledge base, and a smart assistant that answers farming questions in Arabic.
Economic studies on farming and the Sudanese pound.
To the investor at home and abroad… this is Sudagri: a Sudanese platform that brings you together with the landowner, the farmer, and the farming companies… in one place.
Opportunities on verified land: you see its size, its water, and its soil… then you sign a written partnership on the platform.
Sudagri… partner in the land of Sudan, with a contract, proof, and an account. Sign up today, for free.

And the library of studies and research: researchers, farmers, and visitors share feasibility studies and research, which are reviewed and then published… so they become a memory of Sudanese farming, for those who come after us to build on.

And for the farmer who cannot use the app, or has no phone: their verified cooperative acts for them with written permission… registering their land and following their season, and everything stays in their name.
And the forward contract: the buyer and the farmer agree on the crop and the price before the harvest, with a written penalty for delay or breach… so the farmer plants knowing who will buy.
And whoever is outside Sudan buys from the farmer directly… and their family receives at home.
Sign up with your phone number and a password… no email, and no fees.
And layers you choose: the height of the land, the soil, the week's heat, and how much water the crops need.
And over them the canal's route, the minerals, the roads, the railway, and the power lines… so you know what surrounds your land.
In your account, all your land in one place, each showing how far its verification has come.
Your seasons: every farming stage with its dates and photos, and an account book for each season.
Your herd: its numbers, its health, and its stages… a record that speaks for you when you sell.
